headline: Bank of Ghana Policy Rate Cut Expected to Lower Commercial Lending Rates
summary: The Ghana Association of Banks expects commercial bank lending rates to fall significantly after the Bank of Ghana reduced its policy rate by 300 basis points.
why: The Bank of Ghana's policy rate dictates borrowing costs across Ghana's commercial banking system.
why_moved: The 300 basis point central bank interest rate cut directly lowers reference borrowing costs for commercial lenders.
